title: Playlist and Tryouts
author: Ada Halloran
blurb: Sable Okafor, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
